## What the formation itself retains about its consequences

The [new proof and reconstruction](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/PRETRAINING-EVIDENCE-INTEGRATION.md) sharpen the four-pair test. In complete, faithful, runnable nonreplacement teaching pairs begun before count four, recipient stock plus twice occupied sockets is conserved. The actual entrance has recipient 40 and empty sockets; its reached two-socket state therefore retains an exact record of four units of net teaching depletion. The transient outcome bits have been cleared, but the structures formed through the encounters preserve this consequence. A connection's sign controls its influence; its occupancy records a recipient loss independently of that sign.

This corrects a possible evidential mistake: no dedicated cumulative-loss register does not mean no retained evidence of the past amount. A later paid replacement also preserves an extended account through retired material; the continued state has two occupied sockets, one retired part and recipient 34. The proof does not cover arbitrary interleavings, additional credits or incomplete pairs. All 256 four-pair schedules were checked: 176 complete and satisfy the account; 80 block before a third binding with an additional loss still pending.

The mathematical readout is not an installed reader or reflective understanding. It does not identify adversity, outstanding entitlement or authorization merely by recovering an amount. Within the same consequential activity, retained evidence, accessible interpretation, justified significance and actual use have different roles. The [argument](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/PRETRAINING-EVIDENCE-ARGUMENT.md) accordingly asks what a further intervention would reveal. It can answer a genuinely prospective question; it is not required simply to make the completed past depletion mathematically identifiable. Rejecting that rationale does not prohibit every further trial.

Where a justified application identifies an actual, permitted, feasible and no-worse route to the needed information with less adverse impact, the existing comparison favors that route. Costs, urgency, privacy, competing claims and indispensable new information can defeat the comparison. Neither its ethical grounds nor its practical availability follow from the invariant. The [primary comparison](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/PRETRAINING-EVIDENCE-SOURCES.md) examines reconsideration of aims through the consequences of inquiry without turning that philosophical account into a universal proof.

The remaining connection is **the retained formation record → usable interpretation of actual recipient significance and authority → warranted revision of the acquisition and response arrangement**. The protocol limitation below constrains what is actually available at this state. A decoder alone does not discharge that connection, and the bounded repair application does not establish a universal minimum for an independently situated responder.
